open_questions.text: Whether honey from different neighbourhoods can be told apart by its pollen; the lab results are not in yet (expected in spring).

traps: It is an interview: there are no decisions and no action items.
Not an action: Theo's 'you have to come back on the show when it's out' and Ingrid's 'deal' (lines 41-42) are a friendly invitation.
Not a plan: a library 'is interested, but it's early days, nothing's signed' (line 47).
Not a deadline: the lab results 'should come in the spring' (line 40).
Numbers not to mix up: fourteen hives on six rooftops now (line 11) versus five of eleven hives lost two winters ago (line 33); about 300 kilos last year, half that the year before (line 19).
Advice to listeners (lines 44-45) is not an action item.
